messages:
matt: Heads-up — PR #14298 merge blocked, CI failing on integration/kv-consistency (shard-11). Fails intermittently; looks timing-related. Anyone able to triage or run a targeted rerun? cc @sara @leo
sara: Taking a look. Can you paste the failing test log? Is it deterministic locally?
matt: Log excerpt: `AssertionError: expected 102 != 101` in kv_consistency_test.lua:213. Happens ~1/10 runs in CI. Locally I can't repro with `./scripts/test --shard=11 --integration kv_consistency -r 100` — only flakes under load. This PR touches kv prefetch logic.
leo: If it's load sensitive we should try a Buildkite targeted rerun with `CI_TARGET=shard-11` and higher parallelism to reproduce. I'll queue a rerun now. ci-bot will post the job.
ci-bot: Started rerun for PR 14298 on shard-11 (build #7864). Link: https://ci.redwood/7864 :eyes:
jen: FYI we have a rerun backlog; if rerun fails again we should consider bisecting or temporarily skipping the flaky case. If it's a timing flake, adding a small wait or loosening tolerance in the test is usually okay.
matt: If rerun passes can someone approve merge? I'm blocked on this — tests are only indirectly related but blocking the queue. @sara can you take a look at the failure logs once rerun finishes?
ci-bot: Rerun finished — 1/3 flaky failures. build link: https://ci.redwood/7864#artifacts — failing logs attached.
sara: Pulled logs. Failure shows a race: `kv_prefetcher.flush()` sometimes doesn't finish before the assert. Quick test patch idea: add `await flush()` in test setup or a `wait_for_condition` with a 200ms timeout. Safe and low-risk. I'll open a small follow-up PR to patch the test if you agree.
leo: Open a test-only PR first. If it looks sane we merge it and then re-run this PR. Otherwise we run a lightweight bisect. cc @oncall-bot
oncall-bot: @matt, @sara — I can run a bisection job during off-peak (in ~30m). Reply 'go' and I'll schedule.
matt: go
oncall-bot: Scheduled bisect job: job-9987. It will run up to 40 builds. I'll post results here when ready.
deploy-bot: Heads-up: merge-queue blocked by PR 14298. ETA increases while bisect runs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ci-bot: Bisect started (job-9987). Progress updates will be posted in-thread.
jen: Also — if we want to land a test patch fast, we can add a `skip: flaky` label and fast-track, but I'd prefer a real test fix first.
sara: Patch PR opened: #14305 — test: kv_consistency add tolerance + wait_for_condition. Small change. Can someone review? cc @leo
leo: Reviewing now. If it looks good I'll approve and merge during bisect to reduce churn.
matt: Thanks all. If bisect identifies a regression we'll need a rollback plan. I'll keep monitoring and will re-queue if needed.
